coreResponsibility: A UI plugin for Kaltura Player that provides a side-panel playlist component enabling users to view, navigate, and manage media item playback within a multi-item playlist.

featureOwnership: Playlist side-panel UI rendering (vertical and horizontal modes)
Playlist item navigation and playback selection
Display of playlist metadata (name, duration, item count)
View history progress tracking per playlist item
Support for various media types (video, live, image, document, quiz)
Playlist expand/collapse on first play behavior
Side panel positioning (right, left, top, bottom)
Display creation date per playlist item
dataHandling: Playlist item state (active item index, playback progress)
View history user entries (last time reached per entry)
Multilingual name data for playlist items
Playlist metadata (name, item count, total duration)

upstream.name: @playkit-js/kaltura-player-js
upstream.description: Core Kaltura Player providing the playlist API, playback engine, and event system

upstream.name: @playkit-js/playkit-js-providers
upstream.description: OVP provider layer used for making Kaltura API requests

upstream.name: @playkit-js/ui-managers
upstream.description: UI service managers (SidePanelsManager, UpperBarManager) for plugin registration

downstream.name: Kaltura Player UI
downstream.description: The plugin registers its UI components with the player's side panel and upper bar

downstream.name: Video Portal / Embedding Applications
downstream.description: Applications embedding Kaltura Player with playlist functionality

externalApis.name: Kaltura userEntry API
externalApis.description: Fetches view history for playlist items to show playback progress

externalApis.name: Kaltura baseEntry API
externalApis.description: Fetches base entry metadata including capabilities (e.g., quiz) and multilingual data

entryPoints.description: Main entry point that exports and registers the Playlist plugin with Kaltura Player
Core plugin class implementing BasePlugin, manages side panel, upper bar integration, and plugin lifecycle
Data layer managing playlist extra data fetching (view history, base entry, multilingual)
Main UI wrapper component rendering the playlist header and items
Individual playlist item UI component with thumbnail, progress, and metadata
Data loader for fetching playlist-related data from Kaltura APIs

expandOnFirstPlay.description: Whether the playlist panel should automatically open on first play

position.description: Position of the playlist side panel

expandMode.description: How the side panel expands relative to the player

playNextOnError.description: Automatically move to the next playlist item when playback fails

displayCreationDate.description: Display creation date for each playlist item
